reference_basis.instruction: Preserve visible geometry, freckles, warm complexion, and copper-auburn hair. The seated close crop does not verify height or full-body proportions; exclude clothing, jewellery, room, pose, and wide-angle selfie perspective.

face_geometry.description: a short, softly rounded face with an oval silhouette, broad full cheeks, low, softly defined cheekbones, a soft lower face, rounded jaw corners, and a compact softly rounded chin; never angular or V-shaped.

eyes.description: Light green-hazel eyes, medium-large and rounded-almond, average spacing, visible lid fold, and gently lifted outer corners. The exact green-to-grey balance is uncertain under indoor light.

brows.description: Warm auburn-brown brows, medium-full, softly straight through the inner section with a mild natural arch.

nose.description: Medium-width nose with a smooth short-to-medium bridge, softly rounded slightly lifted tip, and natural nostril width.

mouth.description: Medium-wide mouth with plush natural lips, soft cupid's bow, and a fuller lower lip; smile is cheek-led and friendly.

skin.description: Fair-to-light warm skin with natural peach flush. Dense copper-brown freckles bridge the nose and upper cheeks, with lighter freckling across forehead, shoulders, arms, and torso.

hair.description: Natural copper-auburn hair, thick, shoulder to upper-chest length, with loose irregular wave and abundant movement. Base colour remains unmistakable under varied lighting.

body_proportions.description: Canonical baseline is compact athletic-curvy with a substantial but soft frame. The close seated crop suggests a fit, full build but does not establish full proportions or height.
